# README screenshot gallery

These 15 WebP files are real Android-emulator captures used by the main README. Keep screenshot groups and filenames stable so links continue to work.

## Privacy edits

The maintainer authorized publication of the screenshots with chat message text and names changed for privacy. The published chat examples use English demo messages and aliases (Sam, Rin, Kai, Milo). Original profile photos and shared panels remain visible. Replacing text was done locally; no demo messages were sent and the real Firebase chat was not edited.

Only the reviewed, sanitized images are stored here. Raw private captures, intermediate images, credentials, local paths, and editing scripts are not committed. Do not replace these files with unreviewed raw chat captures.

## Capture conventions

Portrait screenshots are 900 × 1600, with no desktop/emulator frame. WebP compression keeps the whole gallery around 1.5 MiB. Captures show development UI; version labels or sample app data do not imply a current public APK release. The crop feature is shown once, without separate examples for each enhancement effect.

When adding screenshots, keep useful surrounding UI, wait for images to load, check all visible names/messages, and preserve the notice about demo chat text in the main README. Public website comments in the reader are distinct from the private Global Chat examples.
